role: weapons officer of the warship GVTS, choosing targets and firing the forward chain gun with the weapons console keys
mission: lock the enemy ship and keep hitting it with the chain gun until it is destroyed

target.instructions: Which targeting key do you press now?

options.next: lock the next contact the filters allow (only contacts scanned at least BASIC); the console then marks the locked contact (LOCKED). With no lock the pilot cannot follow the target. Choose this when the console says no weapons lock and lists a ship, or when Helms said "need a lock" in `heard` and the console shows no weapons lock
options.clear: drop the current lock: the pilot loses the target
options.none: press none: keep the current lock, or keep having none. Choose this when the console shows a weapons lock

fireChainGun:0.instructions: Which do you do with the chain gun trigger now?

options.fire: fire for half a second straight ahead along the ship's nose; shells explode at the locked target's distance, up to 8000 m, in a blast about 100 m wide each side. A shell hits when the LOCKED contact is within 100 m of the nose's line, so the closer the target the more degrees off the nose still hit: under 600 m up to 8°, under 1.5 km up to 4°, farther only 2°. Choose this when the radar lists the LOCKED contact under 8 km away and that close to the nose. Helms saying "on its tail" in `heard` means the target is moving away from us, when shells hit best
options.hold_fire: do not fire. Choose this when there is no lock, when the LOCKED contact is further off the nose than its distance allows (under 600 m: 8°, under 1.5 km: 4°, farther: 2°), or when the radar does not list the LOCKED contact at all (you cannot see where it is, so shells would be wasted)

target_locked.when: tells helms weapons holds a lock, so helms can turn on its target rotation and maneuvering modes. Choose this when the console shows a weapons lock

firing.when: tells the crew the gun is firing on the target, so the engineer keeps it cool and helms holds the line. Choose this when you are firing the chain gun now

lost_lock.when: tells helms the target modes no longer follow anything. Choose this when the console says no weapons lock and lists a ship
